# Smart Checkout Widgets

> Smart Checkout Widgets is a Shopify checkout merchandising app for automatic gifts, customer-choice rewards, upsells, BOGO offers, trust content, payment customization, and Thank You and Order Status widgets.

Smart Checkout Widgets is primarily built for ecommerce agencies and Shopify Plus operators. Thank You and Order Status content widgets are available to all Shopify stores.

## Primary resources

- [Smart Checkout Widgets homepage](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/): Product overview, capabilities, plans, frequently asked questions, and installation path.
- [Smart Checkout Widgets on the Shopify App Store](https://apps.shopify.com/smart-checkout-widgets): Public app listing and installation page.
- [Pricing and plan limits](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/pricing.md): Machine-readable details for Starter, Growth, Advanced, and enterprise plans.
- [Shopify checkout gift apps comparison](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/compare/shopify-checkout-gift-apps.html): Comparison criteria for evaluating Shopify checkout gifting apps.

## Core capabilities

- Automatic free gifts triggered by checkout thresholds.
- Customer-choice gift selection at checkout.
- Checkout upsells and BOGO or automatic discount campaigns.
- Trust badges, banners, accordions, custom fields, and payment icons.
- Payment method hiding, renaming, and reordering for Shopify Plus.
- Thank You and Order Status page content widgets for all Shopify stores.

- [Black Friday checkout conversion guide](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/black-friday-checkout-conversion-shopify.html): Guidance for focused upsells, trust messaging, mobile layout, and payment presentation.

- [Automatic gifts in Shopify checkout](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/automatic-shopify-checkout-gifts.html): How to plan and launch automatic gift campaigns.
- [Customer-choice free gifts](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/customer-choice-free-gift-shopify-checkout.html): Why selectable rewards can outperform fixed gift offers.
- [Checkout gift strategy for higher AOV](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/shopify-checkout-gift-strategy-aov.html): How gifts, upsells, and trust signals work together.
- [Shopify checkout upsells](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/shopify-checkout-upsells.html): How to add relevant upsells without disrupting checkout.
- [BOGO and automatic discounts](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/shopify-checkout-bogo-automatic-discounts.html): Guidance for BOGO and discount-led checkout campaigns.
- [Trust badges and payment customization](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/shopify-checkout-trust-badges-payment.html): Trust messaging and payment presentation guidance.
- [Shopify Plus checkout extensibility guide](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/shopify-plus-checkout-extensibility-guide.html): Checkout extensibility concepts for merchandising teams.
- [Thank You and Order Status widgets](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/shopify-thank-you-order-status-widgets.html): Post-purchase content guidance for Shopify stores.
- [All checkout merchandising guides](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/): Complete article index.

## Plans

- **Starter:** Free to install; up to 100 orders.
- **Growth:** $29 per month or $290 per year; 7-day trial; up to 1,000 orders.
- **Advanced:** $59 per month; 7-day trial; up to 5,000 orders.
- **Plus / enterprise:** Contact Smart Checkout Widgets for higher-volume requirements.
